messages:
Samir K.: Hey finance — I noticed a 3.5% 'merchant surcharge' on my Avis rental charged on our corp card last night. Amount: $18.20 on a $520 reservation. Can we get this refunded to the card? Booking ref: X12345, charged at Avis SFO.

Maria R.: Thanks @Samir K. — can you attach the receipt and the card statement line? Is this listed as a 'service fee' or 'tax' on the merchant receipt? If it's a surcharge, company policy says merchants shouldn't add card surcharges. We'll request reversal.

Samir K.: Pasted receipt snippet: ```Avis Rent A Car
Res X12345
Total: $538.20
Base charge: $520.00
Merchant surcharge: $18.20 (3.5%)
``` I uploaded the full PDF to expense (Expensify): https://expensify.example/receipt/abc123

Finance Bot: Automated note: please tag expense with `merchant-surcharge` category and set "requires-manual-review". See https://go.redwood/finance/policy/merchant-surcharge for policy.

Maria R.: Got it. @Jordan P. — this needs manager approval to file a vendor-claim. Jordan, can you approve a vendor refund request? It's on Samir's Expensify report 2023-11-09-342.

Jordan P.: Approved. Please proceed. :white_check_mark:

Maria R.: Steps I'll take: (1) contact Avis contracts/merchant support requesting reversal to the original card with proof of policy violation; (2) if vendor doesn't reverse within 10 business days, file a chargeback with the card issuer; (3) mark the expense as "pending refund" in Expensify so Samir isn't out of pocket immediately. Samir — want Finance to handle outreach or do you want to try vendor first?

Samir K.: Finance handle, please. Preferred outcome is vendor reversal to the card. If not possible, I'm ok with temporary reimbursement now and recovery later. Thanks!

Expensify Bot: Expense 2023-11-09-342 updated: tag=merchant-surcharge, status=pending_refund, assigned_to=Maria R.

Maria R.: Filed the vendor request and emailed contracts@avis.com with booking ref and receipt. ETA vendor response: 5-7 business days. If vendor pushes back, we'll reimburse now and create an AP recovery ticket. I'll update this thread once we have confirmation. :memo:

Samir K.: Awesome, appreciate it :thumbsup:
_metadata_note: This thread captures a short finance coordination around a merchant surcharge on a corporate card rental. Messages are concise and follow real Slack style.
